exposure: Fetal lung maturity assessed by ultrasound (subjective technique)
Fetal lung maturity assessed by ultrasound (gray-scale histogram technique)
cohort: The study included 77 women with single pregnancies, divided into two groups based on gestational age (28 to 35+6 weeks and >=36 weeks).
finding: The evaluation of fetal lung maturity through the gray-scale histogram (GSH) method was more effective than the subjective method in predicting respiratory distress among newborns.
followup_time: N/A (evaluated after delivery, but no specific duration given)
